title: Curried Mushroom and Goat Cheese Crostini with Watercress
blurb: Toasted bread topped with buttery curried mushrooms, tangy goat cheese and peppery watercress.
steps: Slice the baguette into rounds about 1cm thick and brush both sides lightly with olive oil.
Toast the bread slices under a hot grill or in a griddle pan until golden on both sides, then set aside.
Mix half the softened butter with the curry powder until well combined.
Heat the remaining butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and any liquid has evaporated. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread each crostini with a little of the curried butter.
Spoon the cooked mushrooms onto the crostini and crumble the goat cheese over the top.
Finish with a small handful of watercress on each crostini and serve straight away.
